answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations link behavior across the swarm. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting states, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k^2), preventing stake fragmentation from diluting liability. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, with asymmetric depreciation reducing recoverable collateral; ridge, ferrous, and summit checkpoints preserve auditable linkage.
